Teenoi Suki was once my go-to haven for affordable indulgence—a sanctuary where value for money met quality in perfect harmony. The allure of unlimited beef at such a price point, paired with attentive service, made it a no-brainer for anyone seeking a decent suki experience on a budget. However, today marked a somber turning point. Though the servers still maintain a semblance of attentiveness, the ingredients tell a different tale. The brisket, once a highlight, now arrives looking disturbingly yellow and stale. Cooking it only reveals further betrayal; its texture turns to that of rubber, reminiscent of chewing on a tyre—far from the tender succulence one would expect. As for the sliced beef, its decayed state made it nearly impossible to pick up without it disintegrating into a sorry mess. The decline in quality is not just noticeable; it's glaring. I sincerely hope Teenoi Suki can regain its footing and return to being the haven of high-quality, budget-friendly suki that it once was. The potential is there; it's simply a matter of reclaiming it.
